item.title: EPA permits dicamba for the next 2 cotton and soybean growing seasons
item.description: A significant development discussed at the recent National Cotton Council meeting held in San Antonio, was the recent announcement from the United States Environmental Protection Agency regarding over-the-top dicamba use on cotton.

item.title: Toppin tops Big 12 after wild outing against Arizona
item.description: Following an unreal performance against No. 1 Arizona in their building, JT Toppin earned praises from the Big 12 as the conference's player of the week.

item.title: Warm and windy conditions increase wildfire risk in the South Plains
item.description: Fire officials are warning of the increased risk of wildfires in the area due to dry grass, dry winds, and outside work that could cause sparks, and are encouraging people to be careful and have a plan and kit of essentials in case of evacuation.

item.title: Know your ballot: Lubbock County Clerk
item.description: Lubbock County Clerk Kellie Pinion is retiring after 32 years of service, and four candidates are looking for their chance to take the job come November.

item.title: "We're just stable all the time": Lubbock Association of Realtors give update on Lubbock housing market
item.description: The warmer weather is a good indicator of the start of, what many call, the buying and selling season of houses. Tracy Thomason is the President Elect for the Lubbock Association of Realtors and said this season starts around May but can begin as early as March.

item.title: Texas Tech graduate tells her story in 'Click it or Ticket' campaign
item.description: The Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) and the University Interscholastic League (UIL) are calling on high school students to pledge to buckle up every time they get in a vehicle and always drive like a Texan: kind, courteous and safe.

item.title: Early voting locations for Lubbock County March 2026 election
